# nlohmann/json 3.12.0

Official single header and complete MIT notice, unmodified. Copyright
2013-2025 Niels Lohmann. The annotated `v3.12.0` tag object is
`65ee68451d8eb2b5f3a30b410476ab83deb3289b`; its dereferenced immutable commit is
`55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72`.

Exact upstream URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in `native/sdk-lock.json` under
`common_parser`. Both files downloaded from the release tag were independently
hashed against downloads from the immutable commit on 2026-10-15; bytes match.
CMake verifies both hashes on every configuration. Local `.gitattributes` keeps
the official header/notice bytes unchanged on Windows checkouts. No build/runtime download.
Distribute `LICENSE.MIT` with any bridge containing this parser.
